format: logis-center bias.json node format: every node is {semantic, bias, prejudice, exact_match}. bias and prejudice are comma separated phrase lists that get embedded; exact_match lists words that identify the node without any embedding. 'surface' (an addition of this project) lists complete word forms that match whole only. Vocabulary lives here, never in code.
